title.narrative: Provision of winterization assistance to conflict-affected communities in Ukraine (2024-2025)

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtActed and its partners propose to directly target 14,278 individuals with interventions under the Shelter sector, to provide winterization assistance to severely conflict-affected communities in prioritized raions of Chernihivska, Sumska, Kharkivska, Donetska, Dnipropetrovska, Zaporizka, Khersonska and Mykolaivska oblasts. This 6-month project will leverage Acted’s existing portfolio and implementation capacity to effectively respond to the winter energy needs and address gaps in the broader humanitarian aid response ahead of the heating season. ltbrgtIn accordance with the Shelter Cluster recommendations, Acted will implement two prioritized winterization activities: winter energy needs and winter cash-for-utilities. Acted will dedicate 30% of the winter energy needs target to in-kind distribution of solid fuel (firewood and briquettes) and 70% to cash-for-solid fuel assistance. Acted’s in-kind solid fuel distribution will prioritise Dnipropetrovska (Nikopolskyi), Zaporizka (Zaporizkyi), Khersonska (Beryslavskyi, Khersonskyi), Sumska (Konotopskyi), Donetska (Kramatorskyi, Pokrovkskyi), and Kharkivska (Kharkivskyi, Bohodukhovskyi, Iziumskyi, Chuhuivskyi, Kupianskyi). Local partners Potential (in Zaporizkyi raion, Zaporizka), Save Ukrainians (in Nikopolskyi raion, Dnipropetrovska), Bilozerka (in Khersonsky raion, Khersonska), New Dawn (in Beryslavskyi raion, Khersonska), and League of Science and Development (in Konotopskyi raion, Sumska) will compliment Acted’s support through the distribution of solid fuel to frontline communities. Acted distribution of cash for solid fuel will prioritise Dnipropetrovska (Nikopolskyi, Synelnikivskyi, Kryvorizkyi), Zaporizka (Zaporizkyi, Pologivskyi, Vasylivskyi), Donetska (Kramatorskyi, Volnovaskyi, Pokrovskyi), Kharkivska (Kharkivskyi, Bohodukhovskyi, Iziumskyi, Chuhuivskyi, Kupianskyi), Chernihivska (Novhorod-Syverskyi, Korivskyi), Sumska (Konotopskyi, Okhtyrskyi), Khersonska (Beryslavskyi) and Mykolaivska (Mykolaivskyi). Acted will also provide cash-for-utilities, to highly vulnerable households unable to fully cover their heating needs through electricity, gas, or central heating. Cash for utilities provided by Acted will target Dnipropetrovska (Nikopolskyi, Synelnikivskyi, Kryvorizkyi), Zaporizka (Zaporizkyi, Pologivskyi, Vasylivskyi), Donetska (Kramatorskyi, Volnovaskyi, Pokrovskyi), Kharkivska (Kharkivskyi, Bohodukhovskyi, Iziumskyi, Chuhuivskyi, Kupianskyi), Chernihivska (Novhorod-Syverskyi, Korivskyi), Sumska (Konotopskyi, Okhtyrskyi), Khersonska (Beryslavskyi) and Mykolaivska (Mykolaivskyi). Acted will apply a multi-level approach, considering macro-level guidance, geographical factors, and individual household circumstances to determine the most appropriate locations and modality of assistance. ltbrgt ltbrgtlt/pgt
